import Aesop

set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem continuous_cross_equalizer_closed
  {α β : Type} [MetricSpace α] [MetricSpace β]

  IsClosed {p : α × β | f p.1 = g p.2} := by

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem continuous_cross_equalizer_closed
  {α β : Type} [MetricSpace α] [MetricSpace β]
  (f : α → ℝ) (g : β → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) :
  IsClosed {p : α × β | f p.1 = g p.2} := by
  let h : α × β → ℝ := fun p => f p.1 - g p.2
  have h_cont : Continuous h := (hf.comp continuous_fst).sub (hg.comp continuous_snd)
  have h_eq : {p : α × β | f p.1 = g p.2} = h ⁻¹' {(0 : ℝ)} := by
    ext p
    simp [h, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, sub_eq_zero]
  rw [h_eq]
  exact isClosed_singleton.preimage h_cont
